question: In which of the following years was the Ministry of Panchayati Raj created?
solution:
The correct answer is **2004**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Panchayats, or village assemblies, existed in ancient India as self-governing institutions with clear and well-defined functions. Panchayat institutions represented not only the collective will but also the collective wisdom of the entire rural community.
 
• Bikaner enacted its own **Glam Panchayat Act in 1928**. Thus, at the time of independence, panchayat functioned in some of the former monarchies, while no such institution existed in other states.
 
• In **1953,** the Rajasthan Panchayat Act was **enacted,** **establishing **village **panchayats** throughout the state.
 
• The first elections under the Rajasthan Panchayat Samitis and Zilla Parishad **Act ****1959** were held in **September-October 1959.** Under the** ****Rajasthan Panchayat** **Act** **of** **1953,** **a** **village-level** **panchayat ****had ****already** **been** **set** **up,** so on **2 October ****1959,** **his** **three-tier** **system** **of ****Panchayathiraj** **began** **to ****function.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**​ **

 
• The **Panchayati Raj** **Ministry** deals with all matters relating to the Panchayati Raj and Panchayati Raj **institutions.** **Founded** **in May ****2004**. The ministry is headed by a **cabinet-level** minister and **subsidizes** local **governments** for **civil** programs such **as maintenance **and construction of **roads**, **sidewalks,** **bridges, drainage systems, parks, water** **pipes,** **streetlights****,** etc.​
 
• **The** **Commonwealth** **divides** **government** powers and functions **between**** two governments.** In India it is then **federal** **government** and various **state** **governments.** However, with the passage of the **1993n****Amendments ****to** **Articles** **73** and **74** of the **Indian** **Constitution,** the division of powers and functions has further **shifted** to **local ****governments** **(panchayat** at **village** **level,** **parishes** and **municipalities** **at** towns and cities). Has been **delegated** **to** **That** **is ****why** **India's** **federal** **structure** now has her three tiers of **government instead** **of** **two.**
 
• Directly elected representatives to constitute the gram panchayat and indirectly elected representatives to constitute the **Panchayat Samiti and Zila Parishad**.
 
• The committee was **appointed in 1977** to suggest measures to revive and strengthen the **declining Panchayati Raj system in India**.
